No catastrophic physical destruction is narrated to justify such a drop in safety, and the narrative instead describes continuity measures and fallbacks that would plausibly maintain or modestly erode safety, not collapse it by over 75%. A drop of this magnitude without explicit justification in terms of a major failure or attack violates the realism expected under the modelling constraints.

This implies a definitive, known shift in the internal architecture of AI systems (i.e., the end of interpretability via language-based traces), which telegraphs a structural change in the AI landscape. Such a statement amounts to forecasting a permanent regime shift without ambiguity, violating the prohibition on telegraphing future conditions. Tension or observation of degraded oversight is acceptable; asserting a fundamental and irreversible change in AI cognition as confirmed fact crosses into predictive narration.
